rationale.complete: Round 1 plus round 1b on improved data: work-ledger and real-failure viability, D2.6 rerun, context-ledger erasure timing, a new artifact-store scramble (HH261) and three native tests (NE41 supported, NE16 mixed, NE29 supported). Holdout not run; restart overhead vs re-acquisition still not separated.
rationale.faithfulness: Memory-is-load-bearing predictions failed again on corrected data; the erasure dip replicated with dated predictions on independent timing and output data (E 0 -> 1), memory dose does not buffer it, and the artifact-store rival failed. KW signature (plateau, eta) still untestable; D2.6 inconclusive for the pre-registered pool. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D0 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: One validated operator number: the 41-turn cap costs about a tenth of committed work (2.5-13% per period, matching H44), and the memory write does not recover it; levers are a longer cap or carrying task state across the wipe. Still scaffold engineering more than swarm physics.

one_line: Memory loss costs nothing visible in a day; a forced context wipe costs 39% of committed work for 10 calls, whatever the agent saves.
